title: External access: Ingress, ingress controller and the Gateway API

videos.script: A NodePort opens one port per Service. A real site has one address and many applications behind it, chosen by the name in the request and the path. {{one}} Kubernetes describes that in an object called Ingress. And then it does nothing with it. {{nothing}} An Ingress is a request. Something has to read it and route the traffic: an ingress controller, which is a program you install. Without one, an Ingress is accepted and ignored. {{ignored}} You will watch that happen. Then you will meet the object that is replacing Ingress, the Gateway API, which splits the job between the people who run the entrance and the people who own the routes. {{gateway}} And it can route on a header, which Ingress never could. {{header}}
